acceptedAnswer.text: Answer engine optimisation is the practice of structuring pages so search features and assistants can lift a clear, correct answer from them, such as featured snippets, voice replies and AI summaries.

mainEntity.name: How is AEO different from SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO makes a page findable and rankable. AEO shapes the content on the page so it can be used as the answer: a direct answer first, real FAQs and matching structured data.

mainEntity.name: How is AEO different from GEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO targets answer features in search and voice. GEO targets being cited inside generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini. They share content but the surfaces and signals differ.

It helps machines understand the questions and answers on a page, but search engines decide how and whether to show it, and that can change. We use it where it matches real content, and do not rely on it alone.

mainEntity.name: Can you guarantee a featured snippet?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Search engines choose what to show, and the choice varies by query and over time. We commit to the work in the scope and report which answer features your pages appear in.

A monthly scope, agreed after a call and written down so you can see what each month covers. We do not publish a price list because the right scope depends on your site, your market and how much you want done.

Brands with questions to answer. We do this for D2C, B2B and education brands and set it up differently for each: D2C on products and repeat purchase, B2B on specifications and enquiries, education on courses and admissions.

hub.sub: Featured snippets, voice answers and AI summaries pick one clear answer. We write and structure your pages so yours is the one they pick.

answer.label: In short
answer.lead: Answer engine optimisation (AEO) is the work of shaping pages so that search features and assistants can lift a clear, correct answer from them: featured snippets, People Also Ask boxes, voice replies and AI summaries. It means putting the answer first, in plain words, with structure that machines can read.
answer.who: Monday Marketing Company (MMC) does AEO for D2C, B2B and education brands, as one workstream inside our AI SEO programme.

blocks.h: What AEO looks like on a page
paras: A page built for answers states the question, answers it in a sentence or two, and then earns the longer read. A product page answers what it is, who it suits and what it costs to use. A course page answers eligibility, duration and the next step. A service page answers what you do and for whom.
This is not a trick. It is how a good support article reads, written so a person or a machine can find the answer without hunting.

stages.why: Answer features are triggered by specific questions. If you write for the wrong ones, no feature fits your page.
stages.does: We collect the questions from search, sales calls and support, then group them by what the buyer wants to do next.

stages.breaks: Burying the answer under a story.
stages.why: A snippet or spoken reply needs a self-contained answer it can lift without rewriting.
stages.does: We open each section with a direct answer in plain words, then add detail, examples and the next step.

stages.k: Add FAQs that earn their place
stages.breaks: Generic FAQs that no one asked.
stages.why: FAQ markup only helps when the questions are real and the answers match the page.
stages.does: We write FAQs from real buyer questions and mark them up so machines can read them.

stages.breaks: Pages with no markup or the wrong markup.
stages.why: Schema tells a crawler what a page is: a product, a course, a how-to, an organisation.
stages.does: We add and validate structured data that fits the page type, and keep it in step with the visible content.

stages.k: Check, correct and keep it true
stages.why: A quoted wrong answer is worse than no answer, so pricing, eligibility and dates must stay current.
stages.does: We review claims before publishing and schedule rechecks for anything that changes.

numbers.note: Appearing in an answer box is a means. Enquiries and orders are the end.
